principles: Preserve every v2 value that has an unambiguous v3 destination.
Generate deterministic nested IDs so repeated migration of the same source produces the same result.
Do not invent quantitative throughput, reserves, fault history, bearings, or infrastructure capacity that v2 never recorded.
Use conservative zero or empty placeholders where the v3 schema requires a value but v2 contains no evidence.
Add explicit migration warnings for every provisional or conservative placeholder.
Generated v2 site slots remain planned or unknown placeholders rather than being promoted into fully realized active sites.
Do not register or execute this migration until P1 activation.

deterministicIds.slugRule: lowercase; replace non-alphanumeric runs with hyphens; trim hyphens

crosswalkRules.regionIdToCellId: Map each v2 mapFoundation.cells[].id through deterministicIds.cell.
crosswalkRules.siteSlotIdToSiteId: Map each v2 mapFoundation.siteSlots[].id through deterministicIds.site.
crosswalkRules.cellSiteLinks: Translate each v2 cell.sites slot ID through the site crosswalk and assign the resulting IDs to map.cells[].siteIds.
crosswalkRules.siteCellLinks: Translate each site slot regionId through the region crosswalk and assign it to sites[].mapCellId.

fieldMappings.transform: set 'unclaimed or not recorded in v2'
map chart quality to unmapped partial operational or survey-grade
maximum of width and height; fall back to square root of nominalCellAreaKm2

mapMigration.activeCellIds: all migrated v2 region IDs in source order

cells.elevationM: source motion.meanAltitudeM plus source cell elevationM because v2 elevation is local relief
cells.usablePercent: gentle 80; moderate 55; steep 25; otherwise global geometry usableSurfacePercent
cells.arablePercent: minimum of usablePercent and global terrain.arableSoilPercent for gentle cells; zero for steep cells; half the global value otherwise
cells.waterCatchmentId: water-migrated-summary only on the selected water-anchor cell; null elsewhere
cells.resourceNodeIds: resource-migrated-summary only on the selected resource-anchor cell when v2 mineralPresence is non-empty

mapMigration.waterAnchorSelection: prefer the first cell whose terrain contains basin wet lake spring or river; otherwise use the first active cell
mapMigration.resourceAnchorSelection: prefer the first ridge quarry cliff or exposed cell; otherwise use the first active cell
mapMigration.primarySettlementCellSelection: prefer the active cell with the highest estimated usable area; break ties by source order
mapMigration.primaryApproachCellSelection: prefer the first source cell with access edge-access; otherwise use the first active cell

record.name: humanized source slot ID plus source type
record.status: planned for unassigned slots; unknown for known slots
record.visibility: known-locally for known slots; gm-only for unassigned slots

siteMigration.warning: V2 site slots were generated capacity placeholders. Migration does not assert that they are completed or active sites.

hydrology.sources: Create one provisional water source only when v2 hydrology.profile is not none or empty.

waterSourceRecord.type: copy v2 hydrology.profile prefixed with migrated summary

hydrology.warning: Potability and throughput were not recorded in v2; false and zero values are conservative placeholders, not negative findings.

foodCapacity.warning: V2 estimated settlement population but did not quantify food production.

resources.nodes: Create one provisional node when v2 resources.mineralPresence is non-empty.

resourceNodeRecord.quality: copy depositScale and mineralAccessibility as descriptive text

resources.warning: V2 resource presence did not provide tonnage or safe extraction limits.

altitudeTimeline.minimumAltitudeM: copy v2 motion.minimumAltitudeM or mean minus oscillation
altitudeTimeline.maximumAltitudeM: copy v2 motion.maximumAltitudeM or mean plus oscillation
altitudeTimeline.confidence: map altitudePredictability to unknown low moderate high or survey-grade

driftTimeline.confidence: map driftPredictability to unknown low moderate high or survey-grade

motion.warning: V2 recorded drift speed but not bearing. Zero degrees is a visible placeholder that must be reviewed.

stability.structuralIntegrity: describe the migrated v2 derivedScores.structuralStability value and state that the source descriptor was not retained
stability.overallRisk: map structuralStability score: 18-20 minimal; 15-17 low; 11-14 guarded; 6-10 high; 0-5 critical
stability.warning: V2 did not retain fault locations, fracture history, or annual loss rate.

landingZones.name: Migrated Primary Approach
landingZones.type: map v2 approachProfile to open-field cliff-dock underside-dock or moving-rendezvous; default open-field
landingZones.weatherLimit: copy v2 access.approachProfile as descriptive limitation

approaches.warning: Landing capacity, vessel class, and approach bearing were not recorded in v2.

ecology.habitats: Create one provisional habitat covering all active cells when v2 ecology.habitatAreaKm2 is greater than zero.

habitatRecord.name: Migrated Primary Habitat
habitatRecord.condition: map wildlifeDensity to pristine healthy strained degraded or collapsed

ecology.speciesSlots: Create one dominant species slot when v2 ecology.dominantWildlife is non-empty.

settlementCapacity.settlementSlots: Create one provisional primary slot when permanent population is greater than zero or recommendedSettlementSites is greater than zero.

settlementSlotRecord.maximumFootprintKm2: minimum of selected cell area times 0.5 and v2 geometry.flatAreaKm2
settlementSlotRecord.status: occupied when permanentPopulation is greater than zero; otherwise open

settlementCapacity.warning: The v2 maximum population becomes a land-limited estimate only. Sustainable capacity remains zero until food and water are quantified.

routeCapability.chartConfidence: map v2 access.chartQuality to rumor poor usable reliable or survey-grade

routeNodeExport.warning: The v2 route summary did not quantify arrivals or services.

visibility.playerKnownSiteIds: migrated site IDs whose source status was known
visibility.gmOnlySiteIds: migrated site IDs whose source status was unassigned

derivedRules.geometryReconciles: true when copied plan and derived geometry values are non-negative and internally ordered
derivedRules.compositionReconciles: true when the four copied percentages total 100 within 0.1
derivedRules.mapAreaReconciles: true when migrated active-cell area total differs from geometry.planAreaKm2 by no more than max(0.1 km², 2 percent)
derivedRules.warnings: combine source warnings with every provisional warning in this contract

outputRules.playerSafeSummary: copy v2 outputs.summary or generate a summary from copied classification and geometry
outputRules.gmBrief: join v2 outputs.gmNotes and migration warnings without leaking generated unassigned slots into the player summary
outputRules.wikiDraft: copy v2 outputs.wikiDraft when it is an object; otherwise create a minimal draft

downstreamExports.population: export conservative sustainable and emergency population values
downstreamExports.settlement: export migrated settlement slot IDs and land-limited maximum
downstreamExports.ecology: export migrated habitat IDs and pressure
downstreamExports.route: export migrated route node ID and 30-day forecast horizon
downstreamExports.market: export zero extraction capacity and 100 percent food import dependency until reviewed
downstreamExports.faction: export migrated known and gm-only site IDs as claimable placeholders
downstreamExports.crisis: export no fault IDs and zero reserve days, with migration warnings retained in the parent profile
downstreamExports.encounter: export migrated site IDs and no hazard IDs

requiredMigrationLogEntry.message: Migrated the generated Island 2.0.0 foundation into the deliberately editable Island 3.0.0 production contract. Quantitative systems absent from v2 remain conservative provisional placeholders and require review.
